resources.string: Welcome to Remote Control Hub!\n\nYour device is ready to be controlled remotely via WiFi.
The remote control service allows you to control this device from another device on the same network.
Use this IP address to connect from your control device

Remote Control Hub allows you to control your Android device wirelessly from another device on the same network.


Features:
 • 📷 Camera Control - Open camera and take pictures remotely
 • 📱 Device Properties - Query device information
 • 🌐 WiFi Based - Works over your local network
 • 🔒 Secure - Only accessible from your local network


To use this app:
 1. Make sure both devices are on the same WiFi network
 2. Start the remote control service
 3. Note the IP address shown
 4. Use the Python control script with this IP address


The service will run in the background and show a notification when active. You can control the camera, take pictures, and query device properties remotely.
